The Z3 certificate confirms this by identifying the specific conditions (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9) that generate the XOR chain leading to the impossibility of satisfying Clauses 5 and 9 simultaneously while maintaining the consistency of the rest of the chain.
